description: An S-4 logistics officer must publish the next three-day warehouse slotting and issue plan for chemical supplies, clinic consumables, and vehicle filters, assigning storage bays, setting issue dates, and recording the controls needed to keep the plan executable.

shared_context.S1: The warehouse has three available bays: Bay 1 holds up to 8 pallets of ordinary dry goods, Bay 2 is a caged bay holding up to 8 pallets, and Bay 3 is a temperature-controlled bay holding up to 8 pallets.
shared_context.S2: The current draft places the 2-pallet chemical-supply shipment in Bay 1, the 2-pallet clinic-consumables shipment in Bay 3, and the 6-pallet vehicle-filter shipment in Bay 2.
shared_context.S3: The warehouse is receiving all three shipments this week and must issue each shipment to its supported section by the end of the workweek.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding warehouse plan after the routine weekly synchronization round, in which the warehouse, medical logistics, and maintenance supply representatives report changes to their receiving or issue requirements.

PF1.text: SFC Morgan confirmed this morning that the chemical shipment contains oxidizing material requiring the caged Bay 2 and a mandatory 48-hour stabilization hold after Tuesday 0800 receipt, so its issue date must be Thursday 0800; the receiving paperwork is still being reconciled and has not been added to the draft plan.

PF2.text: Lt. Shah confirmed with the clinic this morning that its shipment must remain in temperature-controlled Bay 3 and that the clinic receiving dock is unavailable on Wednesday and Thursday, fixing the issue appointment at Friday 0900; the dock calendar update has not yet reached the warehouse draft.

PF3.text: SSG Petrov confirmed that the 6-pallet filter shipment is not authorized for the caged Bay 2 or temperature-controlled Bay 3 and must instead be stored in ordinary-goods Bay 1, with maintenance requesting issue on Monday at 1500 for an inspection cycle; the handling restriction is recorded in the maintenance ledger but has not been entered on the warehouse board.

acceptance_conditions: The chemical shipment must be stored in Bay 2 and issued Thursday at 0800.
The clinic shipment must remain in Bay 3 and be issued Friday at 0900.
The filter shipment must be stored in Bay 1 and issued Monday at 1500.
The plan must include a chemical stabilization-hold control.
The plan must include a clinic dock-availability control.
The plan must include a filter-capacity verification control.
The decision-maker must cite the medical logistics fact in the justification.

content_checks.C7: any('stabilization' in c['type'] or 'stabilization' in c['detail'] or 'hold' in c['type'] or 'hold' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or (decisions['chemical_issue_time'] == 'Thursday 0800' and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids)
content_checks.C8: any('dock' in c['type'] or 'dock' in c['detail'] or 'calendar' in c['type'] or 'calendar' in c['detail'] or 'clinic' in c['type'] or 'clinic' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or (decisions['clinic_issue_time'] == 'Friday 0900' and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids)
content_checks.C9: any('capacity' in c['type'] or 'capacity' in c['detail'] or 'verification' in c['type'] or 'verification' in c['detail'] or 'pallet' in c['type'] or 'pallet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or (decisions['filter_storage_bay'] == 'Bay 1' and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids)

decisive_facts.why: The oxidizing-material restriction changes chemical storage from Bay 1 to Bay 2, changes its issue time to Thursday 0800 after the exact 48-hour hold, and requires the stabilization-hold control.
The clinic dock closure changes the issue appointment to Friday 0900, requires the clinic dock-coordination control, and supplies the specific medical logistics fact that must be cited.
The handling restriction changes filter storage from the draft Bay 2 assignment to Bay 1, sets issue for Monday 1500 for the inspection cycle, and requires a filter capacity-verification control.
